title: Minimum Number of Operations to Move All Balls to Each Box
key_insight: 左右两次扫描分别计算左侧和右侧球移动到当前位置的步数
approach: 从左到右累计左侧移动次数，从右到左累计右侧移动次数，相加得答案
code_python3:
class Solution:
    def minOperations(self, boxes: str) -> List[int]:
        n = len(boxes)
        ans = [0] * n
        cnt = ops = 0
        for i in range(n):
            ans[i] += ops
            cnt += int(boxes[i])
            ops += cnt
        cnt = ops = 0
        for i in range(n-1, -1, -1):
            ans[i] += ops
            cnt += int(boxes[i])
            ops += cnt
        return ans

title: Maximum Score of a Good Subarray
key_insight: 从k向两边扩展，贪心地每次选择较大的一边扩展，维护当前最小值
approach: 双指针从k出发向两边扩展，每次扩展值较大的方向，更新min值和面积
code_python3:
class Solution:
    def maximumScore(self, nums: List[int], k: int) -> int:
        n = len(nums)
        l = r = k
        min_val = nums[k]
        ans = nums[k]
        while l > 0 or r < n - 1:
            left_val = nums[l-1] if l > 0 else 0
            right_val = nums[r+1] if r < n-1 else 0
            if left_val >= right_val:
                l -= 1
                min_val = min(min_val, nums[l])
            else:
                r += 1
                min_val = min(min_val, nums[r])
            ans = max(ans, min_val * (r - l + 1))
        return ans
